RSI Trading Strategy in Hindi | RSI God Indicator | Top & Bottom Kaise Pakde | Swing Trading

Is RSI really the "God Indicator"? In this video Chirag Rathod explains a simple RSI trading strategy using multi-timeframe analysis (Daily + Hourly RSI) combined with price action, so you don't rely on overbought / oversold signals alone. You will learn the exact setup conditions (Daily RSI below 30, Hourly RSI below 25, below 15 = gold mine), candle-closing confirmation for entry, trailing stop-loss rules, position sizing, risk management and risk-reward planning with pivot points, with live chart examples. If you want to learn RSI indicator kaise use kare or swing trading for beginners, this video is for you.
